description: This is a shell script for resolving merge conflicts in git, implementing functions for handling symlinks, submodules, and normal files during a merge, as well as managing user prompts and cleanup tasks.

methods.name: is_symlink
methods.description: Returns true if the file mode indicates a symbolic link.

methods.name: is_submodule
methods.description: Returns true if the file mode indicates a git submodule.

methods.name: local_present
methods.description: Checks if local version info is available.

methods.name: remote_present
methods.description: Checks if remote version info is available.

methods.name: base_present
methods.description: Checks if base version info is available.

methods.name: mergetool_tmpdir_init
methods.description: Initializes temporary directory for merge tools.

methods.name: cleanup_temp_files
methods.description: Removes temporary files used during merging, optionally saving backups.

methods.name: describe_file
methods.description: Outputs a descriptive status of a file based on its mode and type.

methods.name: resolve_symlink_merge
methods.description: Handles merge conflicts involving symbolic links, asking user which version to keep.

methods.name: resolve_deleted_merge
methods.description: Handles delete/modify merge conflicts with user input to resolve.

methods.name: resolve_submodule_merge
methods.description: Handles conflict resolution for submodules during merge.

methods.name: stage_submodule
methods.description: Stages a submodule after a merge conflict is resolved.

methods.name: checkout_staged_file
methods.description: Checks out a staged file into a working directory.

methods.name: hide_resolved
methods.description: Uses git merge-file to hide resolved conflicts in a file.

methods.name: merge_file
methods.description: Main function for merging a file with conflict resolution, calling appropriate handlers based on conflict type.

methods.name: prompt_after_failed_merge
methods.description: Prompts user whether to continue merging after a failed merge.

methods.name: print_noop_and_exit
methods.description: Informs that no files need merging and exits.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main script entry point that orchestrates the merge conflict resolution process, parsing options, and processing files.
